notes.title: Devlog #4 - Forward Progress
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p][b]Hey everyone!
[/b]It’s time for another Quest for the Albatross devlog, and we’ve got some exciting progress to share from the past few weeks. Let’s dive in![/p][h3][b]Mountain Biome Progress[/b][/h3][p]Our work on the next major biome—the mountains—is moving full steam ahead! We’ve fully built and tested our first mountain course, complete with brand-new hazards. The art for these hazards isn’t quite ready yet, but the functionality is in place, and we’re loving the new challenge they bring to gameplay.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667090/2126b07cf317b50c19c9dad6505679bebde96ad7.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]More Courses on the Horizon[/b][/h3][p]In addition to the mountain course, we’ve sketched out two more future courses. They’re still early in development, but the designs are locked in. One of them in particular is going to push your skills to the limit… and we can’t wait to show it off down the line.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667090/38ff4be88620bdd4fb0e0c7e51a6a606fe8925ec.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Steam Deck Support & Control Updates[/b][/h3][p]We’ve been working hard on controls this month, too. You can now remap buttons directly from the pause menu, giving you more flexibility in how you play. Plus, we’ve added full Steam Deck support—so whether you’re at home or on the go, you can keep your golf quest alive anywhere.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667090/b7b67d9485c95026df572da9201b3f7d097f6c4b.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Kickstarter Is Live![/b][/h3][p]Our Kickstarter campaign is officially underway! This is your chance to help shape the future of Quest for the Albatross and ensure it launches in the best form possible. We’ve got some great rewards lined up, so if you believe in the project, we’d love your support.[/p][p]👉[url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/eldertreegames/quest-for-the-albatross"] [b][u]Check out the Kickstarter here![/u][/b][/url][/p][p]You can also keep up with development on our discord[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/u9phqx3RpV"]https://discord.gg/u9phqx3RpV[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667090/1e90f0c451fca59c13d36e375eb8ed70e59e988d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]That’s all for this devlog—thanks for reading, and we’ll be back with more updates soon. In the meantime, happy golfing![/p][p]Until next time,
— [i]Austin Lane
[/i] Game Director / Programmer[/p]

notes.title: Devlog #3 – Mountains, Magic, and Kickstarter Hype! ⛰️✨
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p]Hey everyone![/p][p]Welcome to our third devlog! This one’s extra special—it’s our final update before we officially launch our [b]Kickstarter campaign[/b] on [b]August 5th[/b]! Let’s dive into what we’ve been up to the past few weeks.[/p][h3][b]🏔️ Mountain Biome in Progress[/b][/h3][p]We’ve been hard at work on asset creation, and the next big piece of the world is coming together: the [b]mountain biome[/b]! We’re crafting a full tileset for these rugged new environments, and our first mountain course is well underway. It’s not quite finished yet, but the design is shaping up nicely, and we’re introducing some fun new hazards to keep your swings sharp and strategic.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667090/31c59312087471e107ffc19d8b401e8ea4e8286b.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]⚔️ Siege Mode Sneak Peek[/b][/h3][p]Development on [b]Siege Mode[/b] is heating up! We’ve built out a prototype battle map and started creating enemy sprites. While the mode is still in early stages, we’re refining its core mechanics and programming the gameplay loop. We’re not quite ready to show it off, but trust us—what’s coming is going to be [b]epic[/b]. Expect some exciting GIFs and screenshots in a future devlog![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667090/536a609874ba5a8e6b14d734bf01530599804140.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]📖 A Story Worth Telling[/b][/h3][p]We’re thrilled to say that the full [b]game story is finished![/b] Beginning, middle, and end—all mapped out. The tale of [i]Quest for the Albatross[/i] is heartfelt, humorous, and full of classic fantasy charm. We’re now polishing and editing to make sure every moment lands just right, and we can’t wait for you to experience it.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667090/9f4d667e0a41c6e657539d66ec61e4e8f7f7bbe0.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]🏌️ Kickstarter Incoming![/b][/h3][p]Our [b]Kickstarter goes live August 5th[/b], and we’ve been putting a ton of love and energy into making it special. We’ve got some great backer rewards lined up—including chances to influence the world of [i]Quest for the Albatross[/i] directly! If you’ve enjoyed what we’ve shown so far, your support will go a long way toward helping us bring the full game to life.[/p][p]Kickstarter: [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/eldertreegames/quest-for-the-albatross"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/eldertreegames/quest-for-the-albatross[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667090/569037ff04d8cc97554ed2489322e9f571a75a05.png"][/img][/p][p]We’ll be sharing more details very soon, so be sure to follow us on our socials to stay in the loop. Thanks for sticking with us through this journey—it means the world.[/p][p]X: [/p][p][url="https://x.com/Eldertreegames"]https://x.com/Eldertreegames[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Bluesky: [/p][p][url="https://bsky.app/profile/eldertreegames.bsky.social"]https://bsky.app/profile/eldertreegames.bsky.social[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Discord: [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/u9phqx3RpV"]https://discord.gg/u9phqx3RpV[/url][/p][p][/p][p]
Until next time,
— [i]Austin Lane
[/i] Game Director / Programmer[/p]

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.notes:
[h2][b]🏌️ Devlog #2 – Demo Launch, Siege Mode, and What’s Next![/b][/h2][p]Hey everyone![/p][p]The last month has been a whirlwind, and we’ve got some big updates to share. The team has been hard at work pushing forward, and while there’s still a long road ahead, we’re feeling that amazing momentum that comes with hitting a major milestone. Let’s dive into what’s new![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667090/c62f0d99b7250e03216b2f00d0dee883894876c8.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]🚀 Demo + Steam Page Are Live![/b][/h3][p]The biggest news: our Steam page is officially live, and so is our first playable demo for Quest for the Albatross!
 This is a huge step for us, and we’re incredibly excited to finally share more of the game with you—including its name![/p][p]While we’re still in early development, the demo is a fun slice of what we’ve been building. It doesn’t reflect the full scope of the game yet (not even close!), but it gives a taste of the gameplay, tone, and magical golf chaos we’re aiming for. We’ll be updating and expanding the demo over time—so let us know what you think, and keep an eye out for future versions.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667090/4987a41a48b9d5e8d67d19f619858831c466a029.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]✍️ What's Next: Story & Siege Mode[/b][/h3][p]Now that the demo is out, you might think we’d slow down. Nope! The journey continues, and we’re deep in development on two big pieces of the game: the story and siege mode.[/p][p][b]📖 Story Progress[/b][/p][p]The narrative is currently about two-thirds complete, and we’re charging ahead to get that last chunk written. Without giving too much away, we think the story will really resonate with players—it’s heartfelt, a little strange, and full of fantasy charm. Once the draft is done, we’ll move into refining and editing.[/p][p][b]🛡️ Siege Mode Incoming[/b][/p][p]Siege Mode is one of our most ambitious features. We’ve done early prototypes and mockups, but now we’re entering full development. Picture this: you, standing on a magical golf course, defending cities against waves of enemies using spells, precision shots, and strategy.
 We’re hoping to introduce a version of Siege Mode into the demo in the near future—stay tuned for updates as it comes together![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667090/b3e662135e0b8c2f28e8e806a9b3667e28af7fb9.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]💬 Join the Community![/b][/h3][p]We’d love for you to join us on this wild ride. The best way to stay in the loop is through our Discord ( [url="https://discord.gg/u9phqx3RpV"]https://discord.gg/u9phqx3RpV[/url] ) server, where you can chat with the devs, share feedback, and be the first to know what’s coming next.[/p][p]Later this summer, we’ll be launching a Kickstarter campaign to help bring Quest for the Albatross to life in the best way possible. If you believe in what we’re building, we’d love to have your support.[/p][p]Thanks so much for being here. More updates soon—and as always, keep swinging![/p][p]🏌️[/p][p]— [i]Austin Lane
[/i] Game Director / Programmer[/p][p]
[/p]
